player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} di SimpleTak.
Di tablatt, imirazen-ik tbanen am '{player_stone}' ma d imirazen n umsaddaq-ik tbanen am '{opponent_stone}'.

Di tedbelt-ik, fker tasga tazegzawt (s yisem-is n yimir) d aɣer imiraz-ik diha.
Amekkad, '[12]' aɣer imiraz-ik di tasga 12.

Tiddi-ik d aɣellid n yimirazen-ik i yeqqnen snat tiggiwin n tablatt (seg waggur ɣer wadda neɣ seg tama tazelmaɣt ɣer tama tayeffust).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Asebter n usiweḍ ur yelhi ara.
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Aṭas n cellule ur yezmir ad yili {cell_num}. Ilaq ad yili gar n 0 ed {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Tazrawt {cell_num} tella yakan teṭṭef. Fren tazzrawt d tilemt.
